articles.title: Goethe's Forgotten Amber Just Revealed a 40-Million-Year-Old Ant in Stunning Detail
articles.summary: Using advanced synchrotron scanning, researchers peered inside unpolished amber from Goethe's personal collection and found three fossil insects. One ant was so exquisitely preserved they could map its internal head skeleton.

articles.title: A Continent-Scale Fan Hidden Under Miles of Ice Rewrites Antarctica's Geological Story
articles.summary: Researchers have identified a vast, interconnected network of basins beneath East Antarctica, forming a fan-shaped province that links Lake Vostok and other major features. It likely formed through crustal stretching over millions of years.

articles.title: A Once 'Undruggable' Pancreatic Cancer Target Falls: New Drug Nearly Doubles Survival
articles.summary: Daraxonrasib, an oral KRAS inhibitor, nearly doubled overall survival in metastatic pancreatic cancer patients compared to chemotherapy, cutting the risk of death by 60%. The Phase 3 trial marks a turning point for a disease with a 97% five-year mortality rate.
